tool_limitations.limitation: Process-alive validation cannot detect a navigable shell with no initialized scenarios.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a static gate for directly hosted Page types that still rely on OnNavigatedTo.

tool_limitations.limitation: Filesystem recursion is not equivalent to the evaluated item set of a legacy non-SDK csproj.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Resolve Compile, Page, ApplicationDefinition, Content, Resource, and PRIResource Link items and include them in mapping.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md shell conversion table, Plain Frame row
doc_errors.wrong: Recommended a Page hosted directly under the Window without warning that navigation lifecycle methods will not run.
doc_errors.correct: Keep Frame.Navigate when initialization lives in OnNavigatedTo, or move required initialization to Loaded before direct hosting.

special_apis.special_handling: The API carried over; its LanguageFont properties can be applied to WinUI TextBlock FontFamily, FontWeight, FontStyle, and FontStretch. The migration failures were shell lifecycle failures, not an API replacement problem.

errors_encountered.error: CS0101, CS0102, and CS0111 duplicate Scenario, FEATURE_NAME, scenarios, and ApplyLanguageFont declarations
errors_encountered.root_cause: The manually reconstructed MainPage code duplicated members already supplied by the copied SampleConfiguration partial class.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove the duplicate members from MainPage.xaml.cs and keep the original partial-class ownership.

errors_encountered.error: CS0104 DispatcherQueue ambiguous between Microsoft.UI.Dispatching and Windows.System
errors_encountered.root_cause: Both namespaces were imported while the type was referenced without qualification.
errors_encountered.fix: Use Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue explicitly and narrow Windows.System to a Launcher alias.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909, WMC1111, WMC0001, and WMC9999 XAML compiler failures
errors_encountered.root_cause: Earlier C# duplicate/type-resolution failures prevented local XAML types from resolving; the typed DataTemplate then cascaded.
errors_encountered.fix: Fix the C# errors and use a normal Binding DataTemplate where compiled type resolution was unnecessary.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103 App and Launcher not found
errors_encountered.root_cause: MainPage lived in SDKTemplate while App lived in LanguageFontWinUI3, and the broad Windows.System import had been removed.
errors_encountered.fix: Fully qualify LanguageFontWinUI3.App and add an explicit Windows.System.Launcher alias.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The helper searched only bin\x64\Debug/bin\win-x64\Debug, but default dotnet build emitted bin\Debug\<tfm>\win-x64.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent had to inspect the UWP csproj and manually recreate linked App/MainPage/scenario/style files and copy shared assets.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Approximately four turns before the first build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap mapping omitted all external Link items.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent read sibling SharedContent and shared files and added equivalents by hand.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Make Initialize-UwpMigration resolve legacy csproj Link items and seed them into MIGRATION-MAPPING.md.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two failed build rounds produced duplicate partial declarations, namespace ambiguity, unresolved local XAML types, then namespace/alias errors.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Two failed builds before the clean build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manual reconstruction after incomplete bootstrap inventory duplicated existing partial-class responsibilities and mixed namespaces.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Removed duplicates, qualified DispatcherQueue/App, simplified the DataTemplate binding, and restored the Launcher alias.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Copy and transform every linked source/XAML item mechanically instead of reconstructing the shell from fragments.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent declared preserved scenario behavior after validator PASS, but both scenarios were absent at runtime.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: MainPage was hosted directly in MainWindow while scenario population remained in OnNavigatedTo, which direct hosting never raises.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the migration trial.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Document the direct-host lifecycle rule and make Validate-UwpMigration fail this static pattern.
